blockchain.title: Could THORChain face prosecution over stolen Bitget funds?
blockchain.excerpt: THORChain will not — or can not — block addresses linked to the $387.5 million Bitget hack. Can the devs be prosecuted for money laundering? It’s complicated, says crypto lawyer Yuriy Brisov.
